Topic: The Mathematical Trinity: Powers, Roots, and Logarithms

Target audience: High school students (Algebra II/Pre-Calculus level)

Section: section_1 — The Bridge: Prerequisite Recap

Lecture lines:
Imagine a seed growing into a tree.
The base is our starting seed.
The exponent is our growth time.
The result is the final height.
Two raised to three equals eight. [Asset: growth_tree_animation]

Planned animations:
Create title 'Prerequisite Recap' in #FFFFFF at center.
Fade out title, create set of symbols 'a', 'b', 'c' in #FFCC00.
Highlight 'a' using #FF0000 flash.
Highlight 'b' using #FF0000 flash.
Highlight 'c' using #FF0000 flash.

Section: section_2 — Roots: Finding the Seed

Lecture lines:
Now, let's reverse the growth process.
We look to find the seed.
This is the root operation.
The cube root of eight is two. [Asset: rewind_tree_animation]

Planned animations:
Create title 'Finding the Seed' in #FFFFFF at center.
Fade out title, draw Square in #00FF00 labeled 'x'.
Flash 'x' three times to emphasize.

Section: section_3 — Logarithms: Finding the Time

Lecture lines:
Logarithms tell us the time passed.
We measure how long it grew.
Log base two of eight is three. [Asset: stopwatch_animation]

Planned animations:
Create title 'Finding the Time' in #FFFFFF at center.
Fade out title, draw Dot in #00FFFF labeled 't'.
Flash 't' three times to emphasize.

Section: section_4 — Unified Notation: The Magic Triangle

Lecture lines:
These are three parts of one story.
Powers, roots, and logarithms unite.
Base, exponent, result form a triangle.
We slide the dial to transform equations.
All expressions describe the same truth. [Asset: triangle_animation]

Planned animations:
Create title 'The Magic Triangle' in #FFFFFF at center.
Fade out title, draw triangle with vertices labeled 'a', 'b', 'c' in #FFFFFF.
Flash triangle to emphasize the relationship.

Section: section_5 — Application: The Astronaut's Fuel

Lecture lines:
Rockets use this to track fuel.
We solve for time using logs.
Math fuels our journey through space. [Asset: rocket_fuel_animation]

Planned animations:
Create title 'The Astronaut's Fuel' in #FFFFFF at center.
Fade out title, display rocket shape in #FF4500.
Flash rocket to show fuel burn.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===

        self.play(Write(log_expr))
        
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        self.setup_layout("Application: The Astronaut's Fuel", [
            "Rockets use this to track fuel.",
            "We solve for time using logs.",
            "Math fuels our journey through space."
        ])
        
        # Rocket placeholder object
        rocket = Triangle(color="#FF4500", fill_opacity=1).scale(0.5)

        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.place_at_grid(rocket, 'C3')
        self.play(FadeIn(rocket))

        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#00FFFF"))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(GREEN))
        self.play(Flash(rocket, color=WHITE, line_length=0.2, num_lines=12))
        self.wait(1)
